name: Gaius
source: The Commanding General of the Divine Empire's army.  Considered by most to be a military genius Gaius is determined to rise through the ranks until he can become king of the holy roman empire.  While General Gaius does not agree with all of the polices of the holy roman empire, and even sympathizes with the Gail tribe, he is determined in his duty.
